traits.title: Claws labelled with real weapons
traits.description: Each claw is tagged with a real weapon name from the Weapon/Weapons folder, so this monster never forgets its arsenal.

traits.title: Drifts through friends on command
traits.description: A toggle moves players into a NoCollision group in GameSettings.luau, letting this ghost pass straight through its allies.

traits.title: Speaks almost only Luau
traits.description: Nearly every file is Luau, so the creature has learned one language and wears its vocabulary proudly.

character.originStory: Gather round, junior devs. This creature lets players turn into ghosts, drifting through one another by swapping collision groups in GameSettings.luau. Its claws are labelled with the weapons from ServerScriptService/Weapon/Weapons, including BaseballBat, GreatSword and Boots. It has no README, so it tells its life story out loud instead. It promised to pass through walls, yet its Boots claw keeps colliding with the Weapons folder. Keep your coffee warm, kids, and when a ghost asks for NoCollision, politely point it toward the Weapons folder.
